[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Subarray Sum Equals K** [LC 560 · Subarray Sum Equals K](https://leetcode.com/problems/subarray-sum-equals-k/){difficulty="Medium"}

A subarray ending here sums to $k$ precisely when some earlier prefix was exactly $k$ *less* than the current prefix. So you do not search for subarrays; you tally prefix values and look one up.

[Solved in full in @sec-pref-p2-a.]{.card-link}
